risks: Allowed files alone cannot prove a new durable authenticated atomic owner command: server persistence/transport/events are not writable in this packet. Hidden foundation absence must fail closed, not be replaced with in-memory callback support.
dueAt is a deadline; mapping it to schedule end changes semantics. Existing schedule setters clear startAt for Today and normalize local days, so timestamp precision cannot be added by chaining them.

Duration added only to PersonalTask types can disappear in explicit create/duplicate/recurrence reconstruction or leave inconsistent state after legacy schedule changes. Lifecycle migration requires the foundation owner or a reviewed scope extension.
Naive milliseconds-per-day arithmetic shifts date-only schedules across DST; LSX-WP-021 precision/timezone disambiguation is mandatory, not optional UI formatting.
Event supportsAllDay/supportsRecurrence does not imply writable/atomic schedule support; remote identity remains account/calendar/event scoped and events never become local Tasks.
Preview rights/capabilities can become stale before apply; both fields plus owner scheduling action must be rechecked at authority, with conflict/denied restoration and no partial ACK.

task.updated/provider.syncAcknowledged are proposed families; accepted aliases, event revisions and native consumers must be verified, not blindly renamed. queuedProvider is never durable external ACK.
Current v1 saved-view parser/host and route types cannot render timeline just from a new component import. No separate localStorage interval database or parallel saved-view parser is permitted.
All ten locale key additions and actual Electron runner evidence require shared integration outside this packet; tests and UI acceptance are not N/A.
Published RS-BASE-01 uses an older source snapshot and has a Drive dependency omitted from the LSX explicit edge; publication and links are not implementation/readiness receipts.
